t: Fast-acting, solvent-based solution that quickly removes grease, oil, dirt and grime without leaving any residue. It works immediately on contact and is easy to rinse away. Use on metals and glass. Degrease engines, hand and power tools, chains, gears, lifts and hoists, tyre trims, allow wheels and industrial machinery. Flip straw down for spray or up for a precise, narrow spray. 360° valve allows for upright or upside-down application.
b: Smart Straw System for Direct Application
